falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern analog is broken because that bottom formation required lower lows and failed recovery attempts; a clean breakout above pre-correction resistance invalidates the structural bottom thesis and suggests the 'HOLD' signal was wrong—this was not a bottom but a bear trap or continuation pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 implies elevated fear/uncertainty typical of capitulation bottoms; sustained VIX compression into complacency territory proves the market never reached true capitulation, invalidating the bottom call and indicating the current structure is a distribution top, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously makes new local highs
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with rates peaking and rolling over as equities stabilized; a divergence where stocks rally into rising rates with no growth scare resolution proves the macro regime is different—this is reflation/risk-on, not a fear-driven bottom, making the pattern match spurious and the HOLD signal erroneous
